<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

const int INF = INT_MAX / 100;

struct Edge {
    int to, flow, cost, rev;
    Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d) : to(a), flow(b), cost(c), rev(d) {}
};

class MinCostMaxFlow2 {
public:
    int N, S, T, maxFlow, minCost;
    vector<vector<Edge>> adj;
    vector<vector<Edge>> mat;
    vector<int> pot;
    int edges;

    MinCostMaxFlow2(int n, int source, int sink) : N(n), S(source), T(sink), maxFlow(0), minCost(0), edges(0) {
        adj.resize(N);
        pot.resize(N, 0);
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
        int lu = adj[u].size(), lv = adj[v].size();
        adj[u].push_back(Edge(v, flow, cost, lv));
        adj[v].push_back(Edge(u, 0, -cost, lu));
    }

    void toArray() {
        mat.resize(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            mat[i] = adj[i];
            adj[i].clear();
        }
    }

    bool bellmanFord(bool check) {
        pot[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N-1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                for (Edge &e : mat[j]) {
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    pot[e.to] = min(pot[e.to], pot[j] + e.cost);
                }
            }
        }
        if (check) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                for (Edge &e : mat[j]) {
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    if (pot[j] + e.cost < pot[e.to]) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    vector<int> queue;
    vector<int> vis;
    vector<int> prev, preve;
    vector<int> dist;

    bool simple() {
        queue.assign(N, 0);
        vis.assign(N, 0);
        prev.assign(N, 0);
        preve.assign(N, 0);
        dist.assign(N, INF);
        queue[0] = S;
        dist[0] = 0;
        int front = 1, back = 0;
        while (front != back) {
            int u = queue[back++];
            if (back == N) back = 0;
            vis[u] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)mat[u].size(); i++) {
                Edge &e = mat[u][i];
                if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                int nd = dist[u] + e.cost;
                if (nd < dist[e.to]) {
                    if (vis[e.to] == 0) {
                        queue[front] = e.to;
                        if (++front == N) front = 0;
                    } else if (vis[e.to] == 2) {
                        if (--back == -1) back += N;
                        queue[back] = e.to;
                    }
                    vis[e.to] = 1;
                    preve[e.to] = i;
                    prev[e.to] = u;
                    dist[e.to] = nd;
                }
            }
        }
        return vis[T] != 0;
    }

    int augment() {
        int p = T, minf = INF;
        while (p != 0) {
            int pp = prev[p], pe = preve[p];
            minf = min(minf, mat[pp][pe].flow);
            p = pp;
        }
        p = T;
        while (p != 0) {
            int pp = prev[p], pe = preve[p];
            mat[pp][pe].flow -= minf;
            mat[p][mat[pp][pe].rev].flow += minf;
            p = pp;
        }
        maxFlow += minf;
        return minf;
    }

    void calSimple() {
        while (simple()) {
            minCost += dist[T] * augment();
        }
    }

    // The following methods are not used in the solve but kept for completeness
    struct ComparePair {
        bool operator()(const pair<int,int>& a, const pair<int,int>& b) const {
            return a.second > b.second;
        }
    };

    bool dijkstra() {
        vis.assign(N, 0);
        prev.assign(N, 0);
        preve.assign(N, 0);
        dist.assign(N, INF);
        priority_queue<pair<int,int>, vector<pair<int,int>>, ComparePair> pq;
        pq.push({S, 0});
        dist[0] = 0;
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            pair<int,int> p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            while (dist[p.first] < p.second) {
                if (pq.empty()) break;
                p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            }
            vis[p.first] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)mat[p.first].size(); i++) {
                Edge &e = mat[p.first][i];
                if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                int nd = p.second + (e.cost + pot[p.first] - pot[e.to]);
                if (nd < dist[e.to]) {
                    if (vis[e.to] == 2) return false;
                    pq.push({e.to, nd});
                    dist[e.to] = nd;
                    prev[e.to] = p.first;
                    preve[e.to] = i;
                    vis[e.to] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return vis[T] != 0;
    }

    void updPot() {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (vis[i] != 0) {
                pot[i] += dist[i] - dist[S];
            }
        }
    }

    bool calWithPotential() {
        while (dijkstra()) {
            int minc = dist[T] + pot[T] - pot[S];
            minCost += minc * augment();
            updPot();
        }
        return true;
    }
};

class Solver {
public:
    int n, m, k, c, d;
    vector<int> a, f;

    void solve(int testNumber, istream& in, ostream& out) {
        in >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
        int maxl = n + k;
        int T = n * maxl + 1;
        MinCostMaxFlow2 ans(T+1, 0, T);
        a.resize(k+1);
        f.resize(n+1, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            in >> a[i];
            f[a[i]]++;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (f[i] == 0) continue;
            ans.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int l = 0; l < maxl-1; l++) {
                ans.addEdge(l*n + i, (l+1)*n + i, k, c);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int a, b;
            in >> a >> b;
            for (int l = 0; l < maxl-1; l++) {
                for (int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                    if (a != 1)
                        ans.addEdge(n*l + a, n*(l+1) + b, 1, d*(2*p-1) + c);
                    if (b != 1)
                        ans.addEdge(n*l + b, n*(l+1) + a, 1, d*(2*p-1) + c);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int l = 1; l < maxl; l++) {
            ans.addEdge(l*n + 1, T, k, 0);
        }
        ans.toArray();
        ans.calSimple();
        if (ans.maxFlow != k) {
            out << "BUG" << endl;
        } else {
            out << (int)ans.minCost << endl;
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    Solver sv;
    sv.solve(1, cin, cout);
    return 0;
}
